_doc: Known issues found by the playtest harness and accepted for now. Hard gates ignore these so CI catches new bugs; delete an entry once it is fixed and the gate will guard it. Each has the date it was found and where it lives.

violations.where: src/game/demo.ts fresh(): the starting Field Generator (5-912) is in air; the catalogue allows land or water (possibleAmbit 6)
demo.build() never checks TYPES_BY_ID[type].possibleAmbit; only the UI's build card limits ambits (chaos persona)
demo.build() accepts a fleet type in a planet slot and vice versa (chaos persona)
demo.build() accepts slot -1 and slots beyond the planet's 4 (chaos persona)
demo.sell(NaN, ...), demo.buildEngine(NaN), demo.invest(id, NaN) are accepted and turn alpha (and the save) into NaN for good
follows from junk amounts accepted by sell/buildEngine/invest (alpha -Infinity seen)
demo.sell()/buy() accept NaN kW and negative or huge block counts, creating contracts with NaN kW

crashes.where: demo.adopt(unknown doctrine) throws instead of refusing
demo.claimOutpost(unknown id) throws instead of refusing
demo.refit(id, unknown module) throws instead of refusing
